EventAuxiliary_raw_byte_parse.note: edm::EventAuxiliary FAILS uproot deserialization (DeserializationError, edm::Hash<2> version 9). But run/lumi/event are recoverable by a fixed-offset big-endian uint32 read of the branch's raw basket byte segments.
EventAuxiliary_raw_byte_parse.offset_is_file_local: Locate it per file by scanning for the offset where the uint32 lies in the dataset's declared run range for ALL entries of basket 0 — that is how these offsets were found. Do NOT hard-code 43/47/51 blindly.

Constituent-level substructure must be obtained by RE-CLUSTERING the full particleFlow PFCandidate collection (anti-kt R=0.5), which IS readable.
